# A marker with nothing to place

This fixture carries an index placement marker and no index marks whatever.
That is its whole job: the count of marks seen is zero here, so a leaked count
from an earlier document makes this document emit the index setup and the
index itself, and silences the report saying there is nothing to place. In
either fixture beside this one the count is already non-zero, and a leak moves
nothing.

::: {.qi-index-here}
:::

Prose after the marker, so its removal is visible as an absence.
